buildCommand: git config --global --add safe.directory '*' && curl -fsSL https://storage.googleapis.com/flutter_infra_release/releases/stable/linux/flutter_linux_3.32.0-stable.tar.xz | tar xJ -C $HOME && export PATH=$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH && cd admin_panel && $HOME/flutter/bin/flutter pub get --no-color && $HOME/flutter/bin/flutter build web --release --no-pub --no-color
